question: Average speed and average velocity represent the speed of the object:

options.text: At a particular point in time

solution:
The correct answer is __**During the given interval**__.

__
 
• **Average speed and average velocity represent the speed of the object during the given interval.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Average speed**

 
 
• The average speed of a particle for a given interval of time is defined as the ratio of total distance travelled to the total time taken.
 
• Average ~speed = {Total~ distance over total ~time t~aken}
 
• It is a **scalar quantity.**
 
 
 
• **Average velocity:**
 
 
• It is defined as the ratio of total displacement to the total time taken in a given interval of time.
 
• It is a **vector quantity.**
